conditions: The item is an XPath 3.1 array. The first-member rule applies when the array has at least one member.
limitations: An array member can be a sequence. Positions count members, not their contained items.

triggers: Controlling edition erratum, correction, or material counterexample.

statement: In XPath 3.1, array member positions are positive integers, and the first member of a nonempty array has position 1.
